descriptions.w3d_d24b_inventory_tick_8008a8b4: End-of-turn inventory tick: decrements BuffaloRoundsActive when non-zero, walks the 59 weapon counters of the Inventory.WeaponDelays object (descriptor cast 0x80179598; read 0x8025c3a8, write 0x8025c71c) decrementing each non-zero one, and posts two cached messages when a counter reached zero.
